projects.name: Wrocław, Poland semiconductor assembly and test facility
projects.quote: Intel continues to strategically invest in manufacturing capacity to further advance IDM 2.0, and during the quarter announced the selection of Wrocław, Poland, as the site of a new cutting-edge semiconductor assembly and test facility.

projects.name: Magdeburg, Germany wafer fabrication site
projects.quote: Additionally, Intel and the German federal government signed a revised letter of intent for Intel’s planned leading-edge wafer fabrication site in Magdeburg, Germany.
